text: {"lessons":["Ten periods of mostly holding show that routine inaction can be sensible when price changes are random; I should trade only when a decision has a clear rationale.","I should assess any sale or purchase by its effect on the whole portfolio and the stock’s prospects, not by whether it locks in a gain or avoids realizing a loss.","Small period-to-period fluctuations are not a reason to react. I should follow a consistent plan and avoid letting loss aversion or regret drive my trades."]}
